subject: Quick thought on the Anding Family Dental site + a live prototype
body:
Hi Dr. Anding and team,

I regularly look at local practices around Omaha and wanted to reach out because your 20-plus years of experience and flexible late-evening hours make Anding Family Dental a standout choice for families in neighborhoods like Westbrook and Aksarben.

While reviewing andingfamilydental.com, I noticed a couple of minor areas we could polish up. Specifically, the blog pages contained some truncated text elements, and adding a direct click-to-call phone number to the sticky header could make it much easier for patients seeking emergency dental care on mobile.

To show what a refreshed setup could look like, I put together a modern, live prototype for you here: https://nayom-biz-0x87938de21d137e6d-0x11c6d0c698d075b.vercel.app

Feel free to check it out whenever you have a moment. If you'd like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I'd be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you're happy with your current setup!

Best regards,
Your neighbor and web developer
key_improvements: Fixed truncated text snippets on blog pages
Added direct click-to-call phone numbers in the sticky mobile header
